authority.plainEnglish: In plain English, Authority means: The machine with authority writes shared gameplay state. A client can ask.
authority.whyGame: In a real game, getting authority wrong shows up as subtracting with no clamp so health goes negative and the death branch never sees zero. the damage event on this local pawn is the repair, and the generated line `Health = FMath::Clamp((Health - Damage), 0.f, MaxHealth); // node:tpl_health_set` is that repair in C++.
